hotspot_events.title: Aluminum spot premium hits 30-year record, LME inventory at lowest since 1990
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Aluminum spot premium hits a 30-year record and LME deliverable inventory hits its lowest since 1990, putting simultaneous pressure on the cost and lead time of aluminum fins and profiles
hotspot_events.summary: LME 3M aluminum closed at 3,068.5 $/ton (+1.9%) on Nov 11, with the spot premium over three-month futures reaching up to 151.50 $/ton (highest in 30 years). LME deliverable inventory dropped to the lowest since 1990, with a large portion of remaining inventory controlled by two traders. SHFE aluminum December contract intraday rose by as much as 2.65% on Nov 12, marking the largest intraday gain since April 16.

SHFE copper spot Guangdong average price on Nov 12 was 108,560 RMB/ton (+190 RMB), with the premium still exceeding 1,000 RMB/ton. Yong'an Futures stated that rumors of smelting production cuts are fermenting and November output may continue to decline.

hotspot_events.title: HBM4 supply sold out for next year, memory shortage tightens further
hotspot_events.heat_reason: 2027 HBM supply is locked out, spot DDR4 is up 856% year-on-year, and Q4 contract prices are rising again, putting pressure on both board-level memory costs and allocation
hotspot_events.summary: Samsung stated that 2027 HBM supply is sold out, and SK Hynix has finalized volume and pricing for next year's HBM4 with customers. Spot DDR4 in early November was quoted at 46.31 $ (+2.55% weekly, +856% yearly), and TrendForce predicts Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices will rise another 10–15%, with NAND up 15–20%.
